cross_workstream_rules: Workstreams progress independently unless SUBTASK_GRAPH declares a dependency.
BUSINESS_FLYWHEEL.json defines cross-workstream evidence/decision loops; workstreams reference shared authoritative assets/decisions instead of copying truth.
Character canon is required only for outputs that claim stable character identity; it does not block topic research, audience analysis, provider benchmarking or advertiser research.
Account positioning constrains brand/commercial decisions but does not require every episode task to wait for final IP canon.
Episode production consumes only explicitly promoted Program assets/decisions; project-local experiments/candidate takes do not auto-promote.
Commercial decisions may alter deliverables, rights, verified product-asset requirements and measurement, but editorial/product truth and audience trust remain hard constraints.
Growth/performance evidence can create IP/production/commercial learning candidates but never directly mutates canon, provider rules or pricing authority.
Production economics feed portfolio/cadence/visual-class investment decisions; they do not determine editorial truth.
